records.system_name_en: Regional local racing flat-racing programme system
records.revalidation_trigger: Revalidate when the NAR MonthlyConveneInfo, RaceList, or DebaTable route family changes, or when a racecourse-specific parser no longer satisfies complete-meeting validation.
limitations: Obihiro Banei racing is outside this flat-racing source record and remains a separate Work ID.
The initial reviewed monthly promotion batch covers actual meetings through 2026-07-04; later dates require another operator collection and review cycle.
Collection and promotion remain operator-triggered and human-reviewed; unattended publication remains disabled.
records.notes: The reviewed fourteen-racecourse fixture set and selected-month run support A+ public-safe timetable fields for complete meetings from official NAR RaceList and DebaTable routes.
